notes.title: Version 1.2.3 - Egg Drop Rate
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Updated base drop rate for eggs to make it more consistent
[*]Added new Loot Talent “Cradle” that boosts egg drop rates
[*]Updated Talent screen to show the talent description when hovering a talent node
[/list]

This update is to keep in line with our other games to improve egg drop rates. There were various ways to influence drop rates in FSH already but with this update there is now a direct path to focus solely on just eggs with the new Talent added.

notes.title: Faerie Solitaire Harvest Version 1.2.2
notes.content:
[h2]Fae Shop[/h2]
Added a new Fae Shop located on the main menu
- Players can purchase Resources and Talent Points with Pure Gold
- Players can purchase various Card Backs with Pure Gold

[h2]Misc[/h2]
- Added Achievement screen button to the main menu and moved the help button to the top left

Please share your feed back on the shop prices and functionality, we didn't lock the ability to purchase from it behind NG+ so everyone can quickly use it if they wish to (this might change in a future update).

notes.title: Faerie Solitaire Harvest Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added large face value for cards
[*] Reduced the cost of pure when purchasing/upgrading Talents
[*] Removed reduced pure penalty when refunding, now you get 100% pure and talents back 
[/list]

With this update and moving forward MacOS will not be supported anymore, time investment for making builds work vs number of people who play on mac isn't viable anymore. Current version (1.2.0) will stay as is.

notes.title: Get New Faerie Alchemy!
notes.content:
https://subsoap.itch.io/faerie-alchemy

New Faerie Alchemy

Transmute magical elements to combine them into rarified forms. Faerie Alchemy is a more than a match-3 puzzle game. It is simple to understand with deep complexity to master as you aim for higher heights of elements and score.

Benefits of this version of Faerie Alchemy

[list]
[*] New engine, new polish.
[*] Windows, macOS, Linux support.
[*] Full screen support.
[*] Swipe touch controls. Mouse controls. Gamepad controls.
[*] Allows offline play. No internet connection required.
[*] Allows resuming play. You can close the game, come back, and be able to keep playing.
[*] Adjustable piece drop speed.
[*] Instant transmutation feature - no more waiting on animations to finish to play as quickly as you desire.
[*] Higher resolution graphics.
[*] More polish and particles.
[*] More music.
[*] If we release this version of FA on Steam you'll be eligible to get a free Steam key if you buy this version.
[*] We'll continue to polish and improve this version of FA while keeping it feeling familiar.
[/list]

If/when Steam version of FA is released a Steam key will be accessible to those who buy from this link. If you've purchased FVA send me proof of purchase to get this version of FA for free. ːicyfaerieː

notes.title: FAERIE SOLITAIRE HARVEST LIBRARY UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34607415/b8565891ea13bb5dbed156e0ebd73da4347a7b5a.png[/img]

[b]If you have not reviewed FSH yet please do![/b] Every review counts and is greatly appreciated! Total reviews help drive sales, which means more free updates like this one are possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/348910/Faerie_Solitaire_Harvest/

We've been hard at work since launch improving and polishing Faerie Solitaire Harvest to be even better than before. Besides tons of extra attention to detail and optimizations, we've also included an entirely new section to the game we are calling the Library.

Behold the exciting new additions of this update:

 - New Talents where you can gain new powerful abilities.
 - New Lore to discover as you play the game.
 - New Valor for greater risk and reward.

Unlock the Blab talent ASAP! :)

-------------------

[b]Want the patch notes? Here they are:[/b]

[quote]
ENTER THE LIBRARY!
Unlock Powerful Talents! 
Discover Fascinating Lore! 
Show Your Valor!

__________________________________________________________

Goal Changes
- Changing "No Wild" to "Using a Wild".

- Added "Never Break a Combo", worth 1,000 pure.
- Added "Celestial" combo tier, worth 1,000 pure.

- Increasing "Using Wild" bonus from 100 to 150 pure.
- Increasing "No Spare" bonus from 100 pure to 200 pure.
- Increasing "No Deck" bonus from 100 pure to 500 pure.
- Increasing "All-Out" bonus from 1000 pure to 2000 pure.
- Increasing "Left over Deck" bonus multiplier from x5 to x10. Example: (26 cards in a deck = 260 pure).
- Increasing "Highest Combo" bonus multiplier from x10 to x15. Example: (22 combo = 330 pure).

__________________________________________________________

Drop changes
- Adjusted drop rates.
    - Decreased Pet drop rates ~5%.
    - Decreased Item drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased Resource drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased bonus from NGP bonus ~5%.
(Note these are done in part for the new talents buffing drop rates by a lot more.)

__________________________________________________________

Valor
- Added New Valor system.

Valor is an optional system that will allow players to give themselves a more difficult playthrough.

You must meet the conditions to unlock each of the 7 Valor perks.

Each Valor perk you have enabled will increase the maximum amount of XP you get per completed hand and other benifits.

__________________________________________________________

Valor XP/Leveling
- Added New XP/Leveling system.
    - Every level will grant players 1 Talent point.
    - After reaching level 100, your next level up will reset your level to 1 and give you 1 Prestige Level.

Currently Prestige Levels do not grant anything special and are just for bragging rights (you still gain a bonus per each normal level up).

__________________________________________________________

Talents
- Added New Talent system.

We've added in 36 Talents into the game. These Talents will buff various different parts of the game as you play.

You will need Talent points and pure to unlock Talent perks. The cost of talent points and pure will depend on the Talents' Rank.

Some Talent Perks can be upgraded past their initial rank.

You gain Talent points from completing locations (finishing all 9 hands and freeing the faerie or unlocking a loot box) and from leveling up.

Plus a ton of extra random polish, love, and care!

[/quote]

Please enjoy this update and look forward to our next game Dire.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/556530/Faerie_Solitaire_Dire/

Want to join our Discord community? Check the in game about screen for invite links!
